_help: The cars to choose from. 'model' is a real car from the library (cars/<id>: web/cars/README.md lists them), one of the kit's in web/racing/models (without .glb), or models/<name> for one of this game's own; 'length' is how long it is in metres. The rest are compared with the Saloon: 'top' speed, 'accel' (how quickly it gets there), 'grip', 'weight' (who gets pushed around), and 'ride': how soft and long the springs are (soft soaks up the landings and the rough stuff, stiff bottoms out but sits flatter in the turns).

cars.name: Saloon
cars.about: The all-rounder. Good everywhere, best nowhere.

cars.name: Rally Coupé
cars.about: Light and nimble: flicks through the bends, but gets knocked about.

cars.name: Desert Racer
cars.about: An armoured off-roader, fastest flat out. Stiff springs: land a big jump badly and you’ll feel it.

cars.name: Trail 4x4
cars.about: Long, soft springs that soak up anything. Sits tall, so mind the rolls.

cars.name: Pickup
cars.about: Heavy and tough. Nobody moves it out of the way.
